title: The Foundation Built on Forgetting

features.name: the-construction-shed
features.desc-on-touch: A weathered fibro shack where the archive's builders kept their plans. The blueprints inside show coordinates that no longer exist, markings for foundations that were dug but never filled.

features.name: the-buried-catalogue
features.desc-on-touch: Index cards stacked in a pit, clay-stained and incomplete. Each card lists what was deliberately not recorded, the categories the builders decided to forget.

features.name: the-ground-remembers
features.desc-on-touch: Soil that grows nothing but holds everything the builders buried. You can taste copper and ash in the dust.

features.name: the-unmade-monument
features.desc-on-touch: A plinth with no statue, no name, no date. It marks where something was decided not to exist.

inscription: the earth remembers the coordinates of what was never meant to be built; the archive grew here because the ground knew what it was holding; the foundation is made of all the words the builders agreed

reverie.title: REVERIE — the plotting session in the red earth dawn
narr: She kneels in the dust, reading the burnt blueprints aloud.
The coordinates she names are already disappearing from maps.
'This is where we forget to build,' she tells you, pointing.
You understand: not buried, but never-begun. The forgetting.
She smooths the red earth. 'The ground volunteers to hold it.'

file.name: Builder_Notes_Incomplete_pp44-67.txt
file.note: Original site survey; entries grow sparser toward the end. Final page: 'coordinates agree to dissolve. Ground accepts the loss.'
